notes.title: English version released
notes.content:
After a month of intermittent translation, the English version was finally completed!
My English is not good, the text is done with the help of Google Translate, thanks to Google! Also remind everyone that the quality of the translation may disappoint everyone. I tried to translate all the texts, but there are too many scattered texts, and there may be omissions. I hope everyone will forgive me!

notes.title: Instructions for game operations
notes.content:
Recently, some players have reported problems that cannot be archived in the game. In fact, the game can be archived, but it needs to be set manually. The game cannot be archived by default.
Setting method: Open the [Environment] interface and set the [Reading Command] to Start.

In addition, there are other convenient settings in [Environment], such as the automatic end of the round, the speed adjustment of the character, and so on.
Note: Clicking the Esc button in the game will exit the game directly, with caution.
